sources.note: OWNER-SUPPLIED, replaces the 2026-07-26 light-shifted placeholder 2026-07-28: PixelLab character e259a87d-767a-466a-9b6c-c73ab7acbea1, one of 37 states in group 8b4b9811-dcf3-4e9d-baa6-2cb3f8901d0b. THE BROOD HAS REAL FACINGS FOR THE FIRST TIME. The previous source had no rotations at all, so r2 pointed all eight direction columns at a single south frame and the tide read the same from every angle; SwarmFragments.h:60 still records that as the state of things. This character ships 8 rotations, so each column is now its own view and the decode in SwarmSheet finally means what it says. quantize is FALSE: the 4-value lock was superseded the same day (docs/art/aesthetic-direction.md AMENDMENT 2026-07-28, Emberkeep.Quantize 0). That also RETIRES THE REASON THE OLD FRAMES WERE LIGHT-SHIFTED -- they were lifted Dark->Steel because a 94%-Demichrome-Dark body was invisible against a Demichrome-Dark floor. The floor is no longer that colour, so the raw black body is used unshifted. If the brood ever reads as invisible again, that history is why, and the fix is the per-unit distance/light layer, not another manual shift. NO WALK ANIMATION: walk0/walk1 both point at the static rotation per direction, same as the retinue source. Packing cost 0 credits. NOT the nine-variant family -- state00_base..state08_slug still need the atlas rework filed as task-059.

OWNER-SUPPLIED, replaces the 'unit-knight' Hallam sheet 2026-07-28 at the owner's direction ('lets reintroduce the color'): PixelLab character 243c7684-552a-4a73-9be7-046a8c5a9221, 8 rotations, 88x88, low top-down, one of 28 states in group 2cc3ab61-4230-4786-98fa-b94da9e99218. Authored in the web Character Creator, so like its predecessor this is an unmanaged path map -- no prompt or anchor of ours reproduces it. quantize is FALSE, unlike every retinue source before it: the 4-value lock was superseded the same day (docs/art/aesthetic-direction.md AMENDMENT 2026-07-28, Emberkeep.Quantize 0), so this sheet ships in full colour and the post-process no longer collapses it. NO WALK ANIMATION: this character has none generated, so south.walk0 and south.walk1 both point at the static south rotation. The other 7 directions already worked that way, but the outgoing knight DID have a real 2-frame south walk -- so the facing-the-camera view loses its leg motion until an animate_character walk is run and frames are mapped back in here. Deliberate: packing this cost 0 credits.
